You will also demonstrate:
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build productive relationships at all levels.
- Experience investigating and resolving invoice, PO and billing disputes.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when reconciling accounts and maintaining customer records.
- Strong Excel skills, including VLOOKUP and PivotTables, to support debt analysis and reporting.

- Salary of £30,000 to £36,000, depending on experience.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
About the Business

An exciting opportunity to join a well-established services business based in Marston Green as a Finance Administrator, paying £28,000 - £33,000 per annum. This is a genuinely rewarding role within an organisation whose work makes a real difference to people's lives, giving you ownership of the claims and payments activity behind a major funded programme. You'll lead a small, close-knit team and work closely with a supportive finance leadership team who are keen to help you develop.

Main Duties:

As a Finance Administrator, your main duties include:

Leading and developing a small claims and payments team, making sure everyone knows the standard expected on accuracy, output and deadlines

Planning and sharing out the team's workload so that every claim is processed correctly and on time

Keeping a close eye on capacity, quality and productivity, stepping in quickly to tackle backlogs, mistakes or staffing pressures

Coaching and supporting the team through regular feedback, handling performance fairly and building a culture of ownership and ongoing improvement

Making sure the team is properly trained, with clear procedures, guidance and points of escalation to rely on

Overseeing day-to-day claims and payment processing, reconciliations and the related finance admin, ensuring everything sits within the agreed remit

Making sure every team member follows the same checks, reviews and segregation of duties

Investigating significant queries, exceptions and anything out of the ordinary, resolving them or passing them up through the proper governance channels

Making sure all activity is backed by complete, accurate supporting evidence that is stored correctly

Overseeing the production of management information, financial reports and programme updates, making sure they go out on time

Keeping records accurate, current and audit-ready at all times, supporting both programme and financial assurance needs

Monitoring how well processes and controls are working, tracking exceptions and making sure corrective actions are followed through

Getting the team ready for audits, internal reviews and assurance visits from funding bodies

Working with colleagues to spot control gaps, repeat errors and new risks, agreeing sensible ways to deal with them

Handling financial, payroll and personal data securely and with complete confidentiality

Partnering with finance, compliance, operations, audit and shared services colleagues so the process runs smoothly from start to finish

Building strong relationships with funders, employers, partners and other external contacts through the agreed channels, ensuring queries are handled professionally and closed off promptly

Keeping senior colleagues informed on progress, team capacity, risks and exceptions, flagging any decisions needed in good time

Analysing trends and recurring problems to make claims and payment processing more accurate, efficient and consistent, and leading the rollout of agreed improvements to processes, systems and controls

Championing professionalism, a great level of service and real care over detail, while keeping your knowledge of procedures, controls and programme rules up to date

Location / Office / Culture

The role is based in Marston Green, within a friendly, collaborative finance function where the work you do genuinely matters. You'll be joining a values-driven organisation that cares about its people and the communities it serves, with a supportive manager who is keen to help you develop and genuine scope to make your mark.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

Essential

Experience leading or supervising a team within finance, claims, payments or transactional processing

A track record of juggling workloads, deadlines and competing priorities while keeping quality high

The ability to motivate, coach and grow others while holding people to clear expectations

Experience in a busy, high-volume and well-controlled processing setting where getting things right and on time really counts

Strong numerical and analytical skills, with hands-on experience of payments, reconciliations or similar financial processes

Good Excel and finance systems skills, with confidence interpreting data and management information

Sound judgement and the confidence to challenge and escalate exceptions, risks and issues

The ability to turn contract or funding rules into practical day-to-day processes

Clear communication skills, both written and verbal, plus the discretion to handle confidential information

Desirable

Experience within a publicly funded, education or other regulated environment

Experience of grants, claims, payroll evidence or reimbursement schemes

Exposure to audit, assurance or compliance work

AAT/CIMA/ACCA or another relevant finance or management qualification

Why Join the business

A genuinely rewarding role where your work makes a real difference

Salary of £28,000 - £33,000

Lead and develop your own small team

Supportive, values-driven organisation that invests in its people

Broad role spanning claims, payments, controls and stakeholder management

About Us

title: Credit Controller
description:
An exceptional opportunity has arisen for a highly experienced, autonomous Credit Controller to assume ownership of a high-profile ledger within a leading, multi-site food production and manufacturing organisation based in Solihull. This is a fast-paced, high-volume environment designed for a seasoned professional who thrives under pressure, enjoys managing sophisticated corporate accounts, and possesses a natural flair for advanced query resolution.

Working as a trusted specialist within a friendly, high-performing finance function, you will take full accountability for a high-value portfolio of customer accounts to protect group cash flow and strategically reduce ageing debt. This dynamic role requires you to proactively chase outstanding balances via phone and email, accurately allocate complex, multi-currency incoming cash across the ledger, and perform detailed account reconciliations. You will frequently investigate and resolve intricate invoice and delivery disputes, partnering closely with internal commercial and distribution teams to dismantle payment barriers. Regularly analysing aged debt reports to flag financial risks and reporting key performance metrics to senior management will also form a critical part of your daily routine.

Skills Required
- Extensive background in credit control with a proven track record of managing large corporate ledgers.
- Advanced query resolution skills with the ability to navigate complex distribution and invoicing discrepancies.
- Exceptional negotiation and communication capabilities to manage high-value stakeholder relationships.
- Advanced technical literacy including strong Excel skills and proficiency in major ERP software.

What You Will Receive
- Highly competitive premium hourly rate with the financial security of guaranteed weekly pay.
- Premium exposure to massive, high-profile corporate financial ledgers that will significantly elevate your interim career profile.
- Highly collaborative team environment with a welcoming office culture and a comprehensive, fast-tracked on boarding process.
- Clear temp-to-perm progression pathway offering the opportunity to transition into a secure, long-term permanent position for the right candidate.

If you are a driven, career-minded Credit Controller looking for a high-impact, fast-moving role where your expertise will be recognised and rewarded from day one, we would love to hear from you, apply today and take the next step in your financial career.
